description: This file defines two functions in CMake scripting language: 'json_string_to_cmake' for decoding JSON-encoded strings into CMake strings by replacing escape sequences, and 'json_string_ref_to_cmake' that references the first function. It is part of a build or configuration script that handles JSON string conversions within the CMake build system.

methods.name: json_string_to_cmake
methods.description: Decodes a JSON-encoded string into a CMake string by removing quotes and replacing escape sequences.

methods.name: json_string_ref_to_cmake
methods.description: References a string and decodes it by calling 'json_string_to_cmake' on its referenced variable.
